q13.

The `store.Memo` struct is defined in `store/memo.go` (with the `Driver` interface in `store/driver.go` carrying it in `CreateMemo`/`ListMemos` signatures). References span these packages/files:

```
store  (store/memo.go, store/driver.go)
store/db/mysql  (store/db/mysql/memo.go)
store/db/postgres  (store/db/postgres/memo.go)
store/db/sqlite  (store/db/sqlite/memo.go)
store/test  (filter_helpers_test.go, memo_test.go, memo_filter_test.go, memo_relation_test.go, migrator_test.go, migrator_upgrade_test.go, user_delete_test.go)
server/notification  (server/notification/email.go)
server/router/api/v1  (common.go, memo_service.go, memo_service_converter.go, memo_attachment_service.go, memo_relation_service.go, memo_share_service.go, memo_batch_helpers.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, memo_update_helpers.go, reaction_service.go, sse_event_helpers.go, sse_hub_test.go, user_service_notifications.go)
server/router/api/v1/test  (memo_service_test.go, memo_service_benchmark_test.go, user_service_stats_test.go)
server/router/frontend  (server/router/frontend/frontend_test.go)
server/router/rss  (server/router/rss/rss.go, rss_test.go)
server/runner/memopayload  (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go)
```

Additionally, since `Memo` maps to the `memo` table (schema edge in the code graph), the schema files would need review if the change affects persisted fields:

```
store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql
store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql
store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql
```
